title: subscription invocation request, v0
description: POST /v0/contributions/subscription, since Plugin API 0.2. One Record Version's text Parts and metadata (source identity, acceptance time, provenance, extensions) and a batch of distinct evaluations to decide. The core deduplicates Subscriptions that share the same expression and configuration into one evaluation and never sends more evaluations than the manifest's max_batch_size.

invocation_id.description: Unique per attempt; correlate logs with it.

idempotency_key.description: Opaque, stable across retries of the same logical invocation. The same key must yield the same decisions and evidence.

enriched.description: True when the Version has embedding coverage in the active generation. A rule that needs enrichment answers not_ready while it is false; the core evaluates again after enrichment.

parts.description: The canonical text Parts of the Version, in Manifest order. Blob Parts are not sent. Keys are unique.

source.description: Where the Record comes from: its Source Namespace and Record Key, and the Source Position of the accepted revision when the producer sent one. Always sent by the core since Plugin API 0.2.

position.description: Opaque source ordering value (for example a feed timestamp or a mail change key).

accepted_at.description: When Quivr accepted the revision this Version publishes (RFC 3339, UTC). Always sent by the core since Plugin API 0.2.

provenance.description: Who produced the Version. Always sent by the core since Plugin API 0.2.

origin.description: connector for a revision a Connector Instance acquired, client for one an API client submitted. A client cannot claim connector.

producer.description: The producer the client declared, or the Connector Instance id.

normalization.description: Present when an external normalizer produced the published Manifest.

fallback.description: True when an optional route fell back to the built-in text path.

extensions.description: The Version's structured metadata by namespace (for example author, section or categories when the source provides them). Absent when the Version has none.

evaluations.description: Distinct evaluations to decide, each answered by exactly one decision with the same id.

expression.description: The pinned Saved Query Version expression, valid against the manifest's expression_schema.

configuration.description: The pinned Subscription evaluator configuration, valid against the manifest's configuration_schema.

subscriptions.description: The Subscription Versions this evaluation stands for. Informational (logs, tracing): a decision must depend only on the record, the expression and the configurations.

owner.description: The Subscription Owner (an opaque end-user reference of the client application); absent for a global Subscription. Informational like the ids.

configuration.description: The validated plugin (installer) configuration, as for every Contribution.
